note: Floods in Bataan reported by news media in 2026, used to check the flood-risk indicator. Dates are the reported dates; some articles give only an approximate day, so each event has a window. This is not a complete record: a day without a report is not proof that no flooding happened.

events.summary: Flooding in parts of six Bataan towns, Hermosa hit hardest.

sources.name: Inquirer: Floods hit 6 towns in Bataan

events.summary: Forced evacuation and rescue in Sitio Araro, Barangay San Vicente, Orion, as floodwaters rose under southwest monsoon rain.

sources.name: Daily Tribune: Rising floodwaters force Bataan residents to evacuate (14 Aug 2026)

events.summary: Province declared under a state of calamity on 20 Aug; higher flooding in parts of Hermosa, Dinalupihan and Mariveles in the preceding days.

sources.name: DZRH: Bataan declared under a state of calamity (20 Aug 2026)

events.summary: A river overflowed in Barangay San Pablo, Dinalupihan, from the evening of 28 Aug; floodwater up to six to seven feet, rescues and evacuations (also Barangay Pinulot).

sources.name: GMA News: Rescue ops launched amid overnight flooding in Dinalupihan, Bataan (29 Aug 2026)

events.summary: Flash flood with rocks and tree trunks in Purok 5, Barangay Pita, Dinalupihan; nine houses wrecked. The barangay captain said the rocks came from a landslide in Zambales.

sources.name: GMA News: Rock-laden floodwaters wreck 9 houses in Bataan (5 Sep 2026)

events.summary: 845 people from 246 families evacuated as flooding affected 11 barangays in Hermosa, Dinalupihan and Pilar (status as of 8 Sep; start date not given).

sources.name: Daily Tribune: Bataan floods force 845 people into evacuation centers (9 Sep 2026)
